p: Hare and Hyena were friends. They decided to farm potatoes together.
They worked hard on the farm.
After work, Hare and Hyena played together.
But sometimes Hyena chased Hare. Hare would run away.
One day, Hare asked, "If you are my friend, why do you chase me?"
Then Hare asked, "But if you are not my friend, why do we work and play together?"
A friend is someone who is always a friend.
